about: Skips for the Nov 21, 2026 archive. /post had no Skip button that day; the Rules let a McTrotter skip ordering at a McDonald's listed as open but not open. These are the skips I'd have pressed, at the times of my posts about them. The export (recorder/api/src/export-archive.ts) adds each as a skipped check-in at that store, replacing any unmatched tap within 2 minutes.

skips.why: Macy's closed until 10 (my 8:57 AM post; my unmatched tap at 8:57:21)
Canal St closed for remodel (my 10:59 AM post)
